description: An HTML file that serves as the front-end interface for a database viewer application, allowing users to browse and interact with tables and data from connected databases.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays the tables for a specified database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from a specified table with a limit.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates and displays an HTML table from the fetched data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders a cell in the table based on its value, handling null, object, and large values.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands the cell content to show full details when clicked.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays a loading message in a specified element.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message in a specified element.

methods.name: showEmptyState
methods.description: Displays an empty state message when no data is selected.

methods.name: setActiveState
methods.description: Sets active state on the specified element and removes it from others.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches data from a given URL and handles errors.
